review_type: read-only multi-reviewer design and feasibility cross-check

review_findings.design: Use the unexecuted 30-model PACS roster rather than another CIFAR replay, and replace the parent switching-policy objective with the manuscript-aligned full-simplex H/S/B confirmation under a new protocol ID.
review_findings.scientific_alignment: Primary alpha=0.20, delta_r=delta_c=0.05, Lambda=Delta^3, M=12, one budget-512 replicate per model, common H/S/B evidence, and complete 30-model denominators match the v34 core question.
review_findings.feasibility: Synthetic GPU updates passed, but the dirty untracked remote source, missing end-to-end orchestrator, incomplete archived-overlap binding, and unmeasured PACS capacity require an execution HOLD.
review_findings.independence_boundary: Fresh training runs support independent-model confirmation conditional on fixed frames. They do not create 30 independent source datasets or justify population transport.
review_findings.negative_result_rule: A valid negative result is retained and publicly released; secondary budgets or audit repeats cannot replace the primary.
